records.subject: You're in -- let's get Vantage Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days since signup with zero activity: no project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:4bab0a7c]. Only Wrenfield-side contact exists; no customer engagement signal at all. Starter plan, single admin. Silent accounts this cold rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Checking in after your first week with Wrenfield. Nothing has started in the account yet, so I wanted to make it easy to get moving.

Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is the best first step. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Chidi
